title: Edge of the Trench
message: At the first great overlook, a tiny sign hammered beside the abyss reads, "TOTALLY SAFE DROP. Probably. — S" Far below, another somehow remains legible: "Okay this was higher than I remembered." A narrow ledge between them holds {reward} Star Candies.

title: Falling Starlight
message: Tiny falling stars drift through the water like snow. One persistently bounces off your shoulder, helmet, and nose until you finally catch it; with a pleased little flash, it cracks open and spills {reward} Star Candies into your hands.

title: The Silent Archway
message: An ancient arch glows above the path. Someone has written, "Don't touch the glowing part," then added beneath it, "I touched it." Passing through rotates gravity upside down long enough for you to tumble onto a ledge containing {reward} Star Candies.

title: Forgotten Star Collector
message: A dormant Fae collector wakes and requests something "celestial." It rejects a star chart, a cometglass splinter, and an increasingly desperate constellation doodle—then accepts an ordinary shiny pebble and dispenses {reward} Star Candies. Its standards have not survived the centuries.

title: Elven Observatory
message: The Elven Observatory's telescope still turns toward the deep. Its constellation labels now include "Fish," "Other fish," "Suspiciously large fish," and "??? DON'T LIKE THAT ONE." Adjusting the annotated lens opens a compartment holding {reward} Star Candies.

title: Moonstone Runes
message: Moonstone runes ignite beneath your feet beside a chalk translation: "Treasure this way." A second line reads, "EDIT: NOT TREASURE." The misleading route ends at a cosmic vent; the actual hoard of {reward} Star Candies is tucked safely behind the first rune.

title: Forgotten Camp
message: Beneath weathered Elven stonework rests an old but carefully packed camp: a faded blanket, an empty berry tin, and a field journal beside {reward} Star Candies. A tag tied to the bedroll insists, "Definitely not mine. — Shizuki"

title: Moonstone Crossing
message: Each step across the Moonstone bridge rings like a glass bell. Halfway over, a sequence of scuffed stones reveals that an earlier traveler discovered how to play a truly awful little tune; completing it makes the bridge chime and releases {reward} Star Candies.

title: Star Sprite Heist
message: A Star Sprite snatches one of your shinier Candies and darts through drifting, low-gravity rubble. The chase ends when it collides with a starstone box, accidentally opening a much larger stash of {reward} Star Candies. It returns your stolen Candy and looks offended by the outcome.

title: The Stubborn Star
message: A tiny falling star follows you through three tunnels, around two meteor scars, and past every attempt to shoo it away. At last it settles behind you with a cheerful *plink*, and its landing uncovers {reward} Star Candies beneath the celestial sand.

title: Star Snail
message: After you flip a stranded Star Snail upright, it insists upon guiding you somewhere important. Very. Very. Slowly. Ten patient feet later, it proudly presents a Moonstone hollow filled with {reward} Star Candies.

title: Moon Crab Treasure
message: A Moon Crab guards an extremely ordinary rock with heroic intensity. Just beyond its claws, {reward} Star Candies sit completely unattended. The crab ignores them; clearly, you are the one failing to appreciate the real treasure.

title: The Moon Crab Tax
message: An organized Moon Crab checkpoint blocks the crossing. One guard demands a shiny pebble, another solemnly stamps an invisible document, and a third waves you through without explanation. Their little booth conceals {reward} Star Candies beneath its floor.

title: One Step Behind
message: Fresh-looking handwriting on a starstone slab reads, "If you're reading this, you're getting warmer!~" Below it: "Not literally. If the rocks are getting warmer, RUN." The warning's arrow points to {reward} Star Candies, though its age is impossible to judge.

title: Still Warm
message: An abandoned camp contains a cup of berry tea that is somehow still warm. A tiny heat rune beneath the mug explains the mystery, while a note says, "Finally invented tea that waits for me. This can only end responsibly." Nearby, a travel case holds {reward} Star Candies.

title: Fresh Sketch
message: An impressively detailed sketch captures every arch and lens of the Starfall Observatory. Its margins contain berry doodles, questionable arrows, and "Needs more berries." Following the one genuinely useful measurement reveals {reward} Star Candies inside a survey niche.

title: The Shortcut
message: A chalk note promises, "Shortcut this way!~" Its arrows lead through a complete circle and return you to the same Moonstone arch. Somehow the pointless lap shifts a loose stone, revealing {reward} Star Candies anyway.

title: Meteor Scar Crossing
message: A rumble rolls across Meteor Scar Crossing. Scratched into the nearest stone is one urgent word: "DUCK." A tiny meteor screams overhead and strikes the ridge; beneath the warning, "You're welcome" appears in smaller letters as the impact shakes loose {reward} Star Candies.

title: Starstone Rain
message: Starstone pebbles begin raining upward into the dark. An abandoned umbrella has been wedged upside down beneath a boulder to catch them, and amid the softly glowing stones inside it have accumulated {reward} Star Candies.

title: Crystalline Shoal
message: Crystals across the shoal sing when touched by the current. One bears a careful warning: "DO NOT HIT THIS ONE." A tumbling pebble immediately does. *BWOOOOONG* rolls through the trench, shaking {reward} Star Candies from a crystalline shelf.

title: Gravity Fold
message: Gravity turns ninety degrees without warning, dropping you sideways onto what had been a wall. Old footprints cross the new floor and stop beside the message, "This place is RUDE." Following them leads to {reward} Star Candies wedged in the corner where down used to be.

title: Cosmic Vent Bloom
message: A field of cosmic vents releases miniature stars like bubbles. One clings stubbornly to your sleeve, then your hair, before popping free in a bright hiccup; its light exposes {reward} Star Candies nestled among the tiny vent mouths.

title: Buried Sky-Ruin
message: An astronomical ruin lies buried completely upside down, its furniture fixed to the apparent ceiling. Exploration arrows cover both floor and ceiling before dissolving into frustrated question marks. Beyond the last contradictory arrow, an inverted cabinet contains {reward} Star Candies.

title: Cometglass Shelf
message: Translucent cometglass grows from the shelf in frozen ribbons. A note reads, "Before you ask: no, it does not taste like candy." Beneath that, smaller writing admits, "...I checked." A nearby stone case contains actual Star Candies—{reward} of them.

title: Darkstar Current
message: Every lamp and rune goes dark as the current passes, leaving only pinprick stars suspended around you. The lights slowly rearrange into an arrow, turning the ominous silence unexpectedly gentle; at its point waits a sealed vessel of {reward} Star Candies.

title: Falling-Light Curtain
message: A waterfall of descending starlight spans the trench. Passing through paints your equipment and skin with temporary constellations, each movement trailing silver light. Beyond the radiant curtain, {reward} Star Candies glow inside a clear cometglass basin.

title: Broken Orrery
message: An ancient orrery has unmistakably been "repaired." Several planets turn backward, one moon races dangerously fast, and another has been replaced by a berry-shaped stone. A tiny label declares, "Fixed." The wobbling mechanism eventually opens to release {reward} Star Candies.

title: Deep Crater Garden
message: At the bottom of an ancient crater, a garden blooms entirely from celestial dust: glass leaves, comet-tailed flowers, and luminous roots. One perfectly ordinary berry bush grows among them beneath a sign reading, "HOW???" Its roots cradle {reward} Star Candies.

title: Celestial Fault
message: The trench floor splits open, revealing stars that do not match any sky above the Astral Sea. For several breathless seconds, somewhere else seems to look back through the fracture. It seals without explanation, leaving {reward} Star Candies where the impossible opening had been.

title: Annex Signal
message: An artificial signal pulses beneath the trench—neither Elven nor recognizably Fae, but deliberately constructed. Most of its buried housing is unreadable. An old warning nearby says, "I don't like this. Don't touch anything. — Shizuki" The signal abruptly stops, a damaged compartment breaks loose, and {reward} Star Candies spill into the silence. ...What was that?
